metadata.intended_use: Seed map for fast official-source retrieval. This is not legal advice and not final legal authority. Retrieval should validate URLs and cache fetched content.
metadata.coverage_policy: Every subclass from the generated Schedule 2 skeleton index receives at least legislation source + official search/sitemap fallback. Many Home Affairs direct URLs are curated candidates and should be validated before use.
review_notes: Direct Home Affairs URL coverage is intentionally broad but not all candidates are manually verified.
The retriever should use enabled_by_default URLs first, validate HTTP status/redirect/title, then fall back to sitemap/search queries.
Legislation URL is included for every subclass as stable official legal source; Schedule 2 clause refs are copied from skeleton index.
Some subclasses are legacy/closed/niche and may not have an active public Home Affairs visa-listing page; those should still be covered by legislation + discovery queries.
